title: A. Relaxed first night - Roppongi
sub: Grand Hyatt jazz + hidden rooftop. No clubbing commitment; all within ~8 min walk.
budget: ~¥15,000-25,000 incl. taxi home (estimate: 3-4 drinks at ¥2,000-3,500 + Maduro music charge + taxi)

steps.title: Hibiya line Akihabara → Roppongi
steps.desc: ~5 min walk to the Hibiya line platform, then 23 min direct, ¥209 (IC card). Walk ~5 min through Roppongi Hills to the Grand Hyatt.
Warm-up drink at the bar counter (6F). The counter is the most sociable spot. Closes ~00:30 (unverified).
Same hotel, 4F. Live jazz lounge, smart casual. Music charge ~¥1,650 at the counter / ¥2,750 at a table (Hyatt page via search snippet). Open until ~01:30 (sources differ).

steps.title: Walk ~8 min (620 m) to Roku Nana
steps.desc: Through the Roppongi 7-chome back streets. Ignore any street touts.
Hidden rooftop cocktail bar, 3F Verte Roppongi. Cocktails ¥1,700-2,100 (official menu). Open until 02:00, last orders likely earlier.

steps.title: Taxi back ~20 min
steps.desc: ~¥4,500-5,500 with the late-night surcharge (estimate). Use the GO / Uber app. Want the train instead? The last direct Hibiya line leaves Roppongi at 23:55, so you would have to skip stops 2-3.

title: B. Upscale social night - Shibuya / Aoyama
sub: A world-class cocktail bar with no cover, then a rooftop club lounge where people mingle.
budget: ~¥18,000-35,000 incl. taxi (estimate; CÉ LA VI entry not published)

steps.title: JR Yamanote Akihabara → Shibuya
steps.desc: ~30 min, ¥253. Or take a taxi (~25 min, ~¥6-7k) if you are running late.
Ground floor 'Guzzle' bar: walk in, no cover, lively and easy to start a conversation. The basement 'Sip' is quieter and has a service charge.

steps.title: Walk ~12 min (930 m) to Tokyu Plaza Shibuya
steps.desc: Take the lift to 17-18F. Bring your ORIGINAL passport: ID check, 20+.
The Club Lounge runs 22:00-04:30 on Fridays (official site). The Skybar's last entry is 23:00, so only the club side is open at this hour. The entry fee is not published.

steps.title: Taxi back ~28 min
steps.desc: ~¥6,000-7,500 night fare (estimate). Alternative first stop: Two Rooms in Aoyama (30s-40s expat crowd, until 02:00), 5 min by taxi from Shibuya.

title: C. Full Friday nightlife - Toranomon → Ginza
sub: A design-led hotel lounge, then a big club until close, and the first train home. Closest to the hotel of the three, so the ride back is cheap.
budget: ~¥25,000-50,000 (estimate; Zouk ticket via its site, price not checked)

steps.title: Hibiya line Akihabara → Toranomon Hills
steps.desc: 18 min direct, ¥178. The EDITION is in the Tokyo World Gate / Toranomon area, a short walk away.
A glamorous gold-lined lounge on 1F of The Tokyo EDITION Toranomon. Listed until 02:00 (unverified). Weekend DJs per its 2022 launch info.

steps.title: Taxi ~7 min to Ginza 7-chome
steps.desc: ~1.5 km, roughly ¥1,500 (estimate), or a ~20 min walk.
Big club, open 22:00-04:30. Tonight's headliner is VAVO (official site). EDM/house; the crowd likely skews younger than you. Bring your original passport and dress smart (no shorts or sportswear).

steps.title: First Hibiya line Ginza → Akihabara
steps.desc: 05:04 → arr. 05:17 (Saturday timetable, Yahoo!乗換案内). Or a taxi now: ~¥2,500-3,200 (estimate). Roppongi variant instead: Maduro → 1 OAK (23:00-05:00, hip-hop, younger crowd), then the first train from Roppongi at 05:08.
